# SmartDraw

> SmartDraw is an enterprise diagramming and visual collaboration platform that simplifies floor plans, flowcharts, and complex diagrams with AI-powered generation, seamless integrations, and data control.

SmartDraw serves enterprises seeking alternatives to Visio, Lucidchart, and Miro with native integrations into Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Jira, and Slack. The platform emphasizes ease of use, data sovereignty, and compliance certifications including SOC2 Type II, GDPR, and CCPA.

## Key Topics

- Diagramming software
- Enterprise solution
- Floor plan creator
- AI diagram generation
- Collaboration tools
- Microsoft integration
- Google Workspace integration

## Core Platform

- [SmartDraw Homepage](https://www.smartdraw.com): SmartDraw homepage showcasing diagramming, floor plans, flowcharts, and enterprise solutions.
- [Why SmartDraw](https://www.smartdraw.com/features/why-smartdraw.htm): Enterprise diagramming, process improvement, AWS/Azure visualization, and why teams choose SmartDraw.
- [AI Diagram Generation](https://www.smartdraw.com/ai/generate-diagrams-with-ai.htm): AI-powered diagram generation from text prompts for flowcharts and org charts.

## Floor Plan Creator

- [Easy Scaled Drawings](https://www.smartdraw.com/floor-plan/easy-scaled-drawings.htm): SmartDraw floor plan creator features: drag-and-drop, scaled drawings, wall design tools without CAD complexity.
- [Import and Scale Existing Images](https://www.smartdraw.com/floor-plan/import-and-scale.htm): Import PDFs, Google Maps, or photos to create accurate scaled floor plans.
- [Custom Shapes and Libraries](https://www.smartdraw.com/floor-plan/custom-shapes-libraries.htm): Custom shapes, reusable libraries, and team collaboration for standardized designs.
- [Data-Enabled Floor Plans](https://www.smartdraw.com/floor-plan/data-enabled.htm): Data-driven floor plans with custom data, manifests, and OSHA/NFPA compliance.
